text: This is a sample bit: You can think of it as a "short update" page — a single line, a few lines of notes, or a set of photos as a lightweight photo wall. It supports common Markdown syntax: You can **bold**, *italicize*, make lists, or write , and more. Click the **Quick Note** button in the top-right corner of the page to generate a Markdown draft — copy or download it, then paste it into the content directory.
